name: MonarchAiResponseSkeleton
title: AiResponseSkeleton
wrapsNative: Capsule bars in VStack/HStack, TimelineView(.animation) for the pulse
summary: A placeholder shaped like the coming answer (lines of text, cards or a table) shown between sending a prompt and the first streamed token.
whenToUse: When an assistant answer has been requested and nothing has arrived yet, especially for a generated card, table or summary that loads in place.
whenNotToUse: Once text streams, show the text. For a short wait inside a chat bubble use MonarchAiThinkingIndicator or MonarchAiTypingDots. For loading that is not the assistant, use redacted(reason: .placeholder) (see skeleton).
api: MonarchAiResponseSkeleton.init(shape: MonarchAiResponseSkeletonShape = .text, lines: Int? = nil, columns: Int = 3, label: String? = nil)
enum MonarchAiResponseSkeletonShape { case text, cards, table }

options.name: shape
options.description: text: paragraph lines with a short last line. cards: a column of card outlines. table: a header row and body rows.

options.name: lines
options.description: The number of text lines, cards or table body rows. nil gives 3 for text and cards and 4 for a table. Values below 1 draw 1.

options.name: columns
options.description: The number of table columns. Values below 1 draw 1.

options.name: label
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken text, "Generating response…".

states.name: waiting
states.description: The bars pulse with the assistant subtle tint over one shimmer duration.

states.name: Reduce Motion
states.description: The bars stay still with no tint.

appearance: Bars use the muted background, title and header bars the emphasis background; cards and the table sit on the surface colour with a subtle border and a subtle header row. The pulse is the assistant (ai) subtle colour. The high-contrast themes resolve the same roles to stronger colours.
platformNotes: The web lays cards out in a responsive grid; on iOS they are one column, which holds at every text size. The web sweeps a gradient band across the bars from the start edge; iOS pulses the tint over the whole bar, which needs no direction. Bar heights scale with Dynamic Type. Android uses the same names.
accessibility: The placeholder is one element read as "Generating response…" or the label given, with the updates-frequently trait.
It posts no announcement; the conversation announces its own progress.
Under Reduce Motion the pulse stops and the bars stay.
edgeCases: lines and columns below 1 draw one line, card, row or column.
A single text line is full width; with several, the last one is shorter.
Many table columns get narrow bars; widths are fractions of each cell.
